newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwe key index gains on heavyweight counters.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwe key index gains on heavyweight counters.

text.p: Zimbabwe's key industrial index was boosted on Wednesday by gains in heavyweight stocks as the bourse resumed its upward march.

Brokers said 10-cent gains in banking group Barclays at 1,950 and sugar producer Hippo Valley at 760 had led a pack of several stocks in pushing the 57-counter industrial index higher, a day after dropping more than 18 points under pressure from profit-taking.

Many local analysts expect the Zimbabwe Stock Exchange to stay on a firm course into the new year amid expectations that the agriculture-powered economy will have normal rains in the farming season starting in November.
"The positive view was dominant today as we are expecting on the whole, but those gains in Barclays and Hippo were the most significant for the day," one broker said.
The seven-share mining index -- 127.02 points down on Tuesday -- was pushed 37.55 points down on Wednesday by a huge loss in gold giants Ashanti.
Ashanti plunged 500 cents to 13,500, a move which brokers said coincided with the share's poor fortunes on the London stock market.
The mining index closed at 1,204.41 in generally quiet trade.
